checkpoint.label: checkpoint
checkpoint.cmd: pip install --no-cache-dir --quiet --disable-pip-version-check six==1.17.0 && mkdir -p /opt/probe && python -c 'import six; print(six.__version__)' > /opt/probe/marker.txt && cat /opt/probe/marker.txt

runs.label: busy_10s
runs.cmd: python -c "import time; t=time.time(); [0 for _ in iter(lambda: time.time() - t < 10, False)]"
